items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: So anyway that night Gerry Mulligan, Hawk, Charlie Shavers and all of them went by the Metropole, I says come on with me... So anyway Gerry Mulligan and all of us went up to Jim and Andy's

ctx.x: What sounded good to him, that's what he did. And boy, I went around there and heard it. Cozy, go around there and hear it, it just sounds great. What are you

going to do, I think you got a number one hit. So anyway that night Gerry Mulligan, Hawk, Charlie Shavers and all of them went by the Metropole, I says come on with me, I said I want you to hear the record because in the Metropole we'd been playing the damn thing but it was like News, the Daily News, you know what the Metropole was like, behind the bar and we all reading and scuffling with it. So anyway Gerry Mulligan and all of us went up to Jim and Andy's, a place where all the musicians used to hang, Billie…
